meta.name: lead-capture
meta.description: Converts anonymous traffic into known contacts — lead magnets, gated content, free tools, popups, and the forms behind them. Use this to design or improve a lead magnet, plan a free tool, add or fix popups and overlays, improve form conversion, or decide what is worth gating and what should stay open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把匿名访客变成可跟进的潜在客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做网站或落地页,想把访问者转化为可联系的销售线索。
copy.tagline_en: Turn anonymous visitors into trackable leads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to turn visitors into sales leads.

howto.what: 当用户提出线索捕获相关需求，Claude 会依据原文规则给出建议：区分哪些内容值得门控、哪些应免费；改进内容诱饵的实用性与阶段匹配；规划独立有用的免费工具；将弹窗改为行为触发、每访客一次；精简表单字段。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计或改进内容诱饵、规划免费工具、添加或修复弹窗，或处理其他线索捕获问题时触发。

say.text: 我想设计一个内容诱饵，让访客愿意留下邮箱。
say.note: Claude 会按实用性测试给出设计建议。

say.text: 帮我把弹窗改成离开页面时才弹出。
say.note: Claude 会建议行为触发而不是时间触发。

say.text: 表单字段太多，转化率低，怎么精简？
say.note: Claude 会建议只留真正需要的字段。

howto.what_en: When asked about lead capture, Claude gives advice based on the skill: what to gate, how to make lead magnets useful, how to plan free tools, when to show popups (behavior-based, once per visitor), and how to trim forms.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests design or improvement of lead magnets, planning a free tool, adding or fixing popups, improving forms, or deciding what to gate.

say_en.text: I want to design a lead magnet that gets people to give their email.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the 'would they pay a little' test.

say_en.text: Change my popup to appear on exit intent instead of after 3 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude recommends trigger on behavior, not time.

say_en.text: My form has too many fields and low conversion. How do I cut down?
say_en.note: Claude advises keeping only fields used downstream.
